description: Delete an existing play log row owned by the authenticated user. Use the play log id from a prior list — these are NOT game ids. Decrements the game's plays_count via the same DB trigger that powers undo_last_play. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

playLogId.description: Play log row UUID to delete — not a game id.

name: kineticist_delete_play_log
title: Delete a play
